passages.note: The July 2023 agreement grants limited royalty-free rights subject to conditions. Distributors must provide the agreement to recipients and retain an attribution notice; it restricts use of the materials or their outputs to improve other large language models except Llama 2 and its derivatives. A separate grant can be required for licensees exceeding the specified threshold.
